messages:
oliver: AM check-in — quick standup on ShadowHealth pilot. Yesterday: demo with their infra team went fine; they asked for BYOK + HSM integration options and an on-prem backup plan. Blockers: need clear answer on HSM/keywrap latency SLAs and on whether we can support key signing policies for their FIPS workflow. Today: following up with eng and security, prepping a short doc for the customer.

maria: thanks — heads-up that legal also asked for cifar of data retention in Private. I'll add to the doc and tag them. Can you drop a one-pager link when it's ready? :raised_hands:

sam: re HSM latency SLAs — eng-runtime asked for typical numbers and a test harness. short answer: we can hit sub-10ms on NVL-based HSMs in dedicated, but on prem depends on customer network. I'll draft a perf note by EOD.

jess: pinging eng-ml and eng-sre to confirm measurable SLOs for key operations. Also, ShadowHealth asked about integration pattern: KMS proxy vs direct HSM calls. preference from customers? @kai any input from previous pilots?

kai: in past pilots customers preferred KMS proxy for easier rotation and auditing. direct HSM sometimes required for certified HSM workflows (BYOK). We should present both options with trade-offs. I can share the audit template we used. linking later.

sec-bot: NOTE: ShadowHealth requested SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence. Uploaded latest reports to drive: https://drive.redwood/reports/SOC2_2025_v2

oliver: updated — added high-level trade-offs and asked eng for latency note. Maria I'll post the one-pager here when ready. Also asked ShadowHealth for sample network topology so eng can estimate on-prem latency.

maria: can someone confirm whether Dedicated supports customer-managed HSM via private network today? I have a demo next Tue and need the answer. If not, need fallback messaging.

sam: confirm: Dedicated supports HSM through VPC peering and customer HSMs via IP allowlist; we'll need to validate firewall rules and possibly open gRPC ports. I'll create a checklist: firewall, port list, certs required.

jess: CR ping — I left a comment on PR #492 for the HSM client timeout defaults. Need a quick review so we can ship the perf note with updated defaults.

oliver: noted. tagging @maria for demo prep, @sam for checklist, @jess for PR. Any immediate blockers else? If not, I'll consolidate answers and send ShadowHealth a single-slide summary tonight.

kai: small ask — include a short section on fallback behavior if HSM unreachable (model routing to hosted variant). Shadow wants guarantees about uptime impact.

maria: yes please include fallback plan and a simple matrix: HSM reachable / unreachable -> impact description.

oliver: great — will do. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
